name: Grilled pig intestine
summary: Young pig intestine boiled briefly, seasoned with scallion, garlic, and chili, then rolled on a stick and grilled.
origin: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
howToEat: From the stick, at a guest meal, a wedding, or Tết.
where: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn, along the Đà.
seoTitle: Ruot lon nuong in Mai Son — grilled pig intestine
seoDescription: Ruột lợn non nướng at bản Heo, Tà Hộc, Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet boils it about 2 minutes, seasons it, and grills it.
